gen-gf-grandstander-gf-saira-semi-conden: Grandstander draws its big, bold letters with plain constant-width lines and short ascenders, which gives headings real personality. Saira Semi Condensed follows with a magnified-looking, steady text.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-secular-one: Secular One is a sans with a dominant midsection that swallows the line's height and no modulation anywhere in it. Grandstander is the one to lean on for expressive, open-shaped display lines, while this body just holds the line steady.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-smooch-sans: Expressive is the first word Grandstander earns, its lines drawn like wire with short ascenders and open shapes. And Smooch Sans, a plain sans with a high midline and tightly packed gaps, is the lighter counterweight below.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-sofia-sans-conden: Sofia Sans Condensed has a big x-height and tight ascender room. Grandstander sits above it with bold, open letters and short ascenders, so the heading feels loud while the plain sans below stays friendly and compact, with curves that never finish their loops.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-spline-sans-mono: Precise is the word for Spline Sans Mono, whose lowercase nearly matches its capitals in fixed-width, code-style letters. But Grandstander, bold and expressive with open shapes, loosens the whole page above that monospace rigor.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-tiny5: Tiny5 is a sans-serif with such a tall body that its ascenders look short. Its strongest quality is the contrast with Grandstander, whose curves stay as thin as a drawn thread while the bold display letters sit above.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-truculenta: Approachable describes Truculenta, a plain sans with short ascenders, a tall x-height and crowded, compact letters. And Grandstander meets it with bold, open display shapes that share those short ascenders, so heading and text feel related.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-ubuntu: Grandstander's lines are plain and constant-width, with open shapes and a tall x-height. Ubuntu, a plain sans with a lofty lowercase band, sits underneath as a soft, featureless hum that lets the heading do the talking.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-victor-mono: Grandstander is bold and expressive, with open shapes and short ascenders. It shines at big display lines, while Victor Mono, a monospace with unfinished bowls and loose spacing between glyphs, handles precise, structured text.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-viga: Viga reads as a sans with hairline-free, shadow-free strokes, and its capitals barely stand taller than their neighbors. Yet Grandstander is the one built for expressive, open display lines, while Viga simply keeps the text going.
